title: From building CoPilot as GitHub CTO to building a code foundation model at Poolside w/Jason Warner
description:
In this episode of AI Native Dev, Guy Podjarny sits down with Jason Warner, a veteran in software development and AI. Jason's impressive career includes roles such as CTO at GitHub, where he contributed to the creation of GitHub Actions and GitHub Copilot, GM at Heroku, and positions at Canonical and Redpoint Ventures. Now, as the founder of Poolside, Jason focuses on developing state-of-the-art language models for software development. This episode covers the evolution of code generation, the impact of AI on software development, the challenges and limitations of current models, and speculations on the future role of developers in an AI-native world.

Chapters
00:16 Introduction - Guy Podjarny introduces Jason Warner and outlines his impressive career.
01:39 Jason Warner's Journey to Poolside - Jason's career from GitHub to founding Poolside.
02:27 Foundations of Code Generation with LLMs - How Large Language Models (LLMs) are revolutionizing code generation.
04:15 Code-Specific Models vs. General Purpose Models - The differences and benefits of domain-specific models.
09:04 The Evolution of Code Generation Models - Examples and the current state of code generation.
15:49 Challenges and Limitations of Current LLMs - Identifying the boundaries of current models in code generation.
32:47 Training on Customer Code and Context - The importance of customer-specific data in model training.
44:29 The Future of AI in Software Development - Speculations on the future of AI and autonomous developers.
54:16 The Role of Developers in an AI-Native World - How the role of developers is likely to evolve.
